build_image_dataset: build an ImageDataset instance from argparse Namespace with multimodal benchmark parameters
run_sample_image_requests: run sample_image_requests to generate a list of DatasetRow objects with random images and prompts
parse_image_resolution: parse image resolution string into width and height tuple supporting presets and custom formats
create_mm_data_row: create a DatasetRow with multimodal prompt, token counts, and image data for a given processor and backend
test_image_dataset_load: test the ImageDataset.load method to generate benchmark dataset rows with configurable image parameters
